eventMetadata.context_description: Current numerical weather models point to a San Francisco high temperature in the mid-to-upper 60s on June 2, with trader probabilities nearly even between 66-67°F and 68°F or higher because of uncertainty over peak afternoon heating. These values sit slightly below the long-term June average high of roughly 22–24 °C, reflecting a transient cooler air mass rather than any broader seasonal anomaly. Updated model guidance and real-time observations through the evening of June 2 will refine the precise maximum before the market resolves.
